test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A vehicle before overhauling requires 5over6 h service time every 90 days, while after overhauling it requires 5over6 h service time every 120 days. What fraction of the pre - overhauling services time is saved in the latter case?
solution:
**Given:**

Service time before overhauling = 5/6 hours every 90 days

Service time after overhauling = 5/6 hours every 120 days

**Formula Used:**

Fraction of service time saved = (Service time before overhauling - Service time after overhauling) / Service time before overhauling

**Calculation:**

Service time before overhauling in a year (360 days) = (5/6) × (360/90)

Service time before overhauling in a year = (5/6) × 4

Service time before overhauling in a year = 20/6

Service time before overhauling in a year = 10/3 hours

Service time after overhauling in a year (360 days) = (5/6) × (360/120)

Service time after overhauling in a year = (5/6) × 3

Service time after overhauling in a year = 15/6

Service time after overhauling in a year = 5/2 hours

Fraction of service time saved = ((10/3) - (5/2)) / (10/3)

Fraction of service time saved = ((20/6) - (15/6)) / (10/3)

Fraction of service time saved = (5/6) / (10/3)

Fraction of service time saved = (5/6) × (3/10)

Fraction of service time saved = 15/60

Fraction of service time saved = 1/4

**The fraction of the pre-overhauling service time saved is 1/4.**
